data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aletheia', meaning 'truth' or 'reality'. In Greek philosophy, alethia is the personification of truth and the goddess of prophecy. In Christianity, it represents the divine truth revealed in the Bible. The name Alethia carries the meaning “Truth, reality” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alethia usually hope their child will grow to embody truth, reality and live with faith, good character and purpose.
